data.name: Frasco
data.long_meaning: The name Frasco is derived from the Latin word 'fraschus' which means 'little box' or 'container'. In the early Christian era, this name was given to infants born in a stable or manger. It symbolizes the cradle of life, signifying the humble beginnings and the promise of a prosperous future.
